name: CREW_LIARA
silhouette: lean agile, hair UP in a high swept cyberpunk bun (NO antennae, NO tentacles, nothing hanging off the head). Matte black + electric violet. One armored violet pauldron (left), one bare sleeve. A single neural-fiber strand traces from the hairline to the left ear. Violet iris rings. Sharp, dark-featured, determined. Semi-Liara-ish homage, grounded and human, cyberpunk.
